metadata.description: Shared rules, selected skills, configurable review roles and hooks for Claude, Codex and Cursor. Install only the components you choose.

plugins.name: guard-rails
plugins.description: Safety rails on Bash. DENIES: uncapped file dumps into context (points at Read/Grep), a re-dump of a file already in context, git commits missing the Claude trailers, --amend on pushed history, a second unpushed commit on a branch. ASKS before: force-push, reset --hard, git clean -f, branch delete, stash drop, worktree remove, two-dot diffs against a base. Nudges on comment-heavy edits. Silent on everything else.

plugins.name: prod-data
plugins.description: Read-only production data. DENIES raw MySQL clients by any spelling, MySQL drivers from scripts, a swapped ro-mysql client and Keychain secret reads. Ships ro-mysql (one read-only statement per call over the ~/.ssh/config db-tunnel-* forwards, Keychain credentials, staging/prod labels) and bqro (dry-run, SELECT-only, byte cap) on PATH, the debug skill (RCA method and data-reading traps), and a nudge to load it on prod-data prompts. Company schemas and hosts come from ~/.claude/local/.

plugins.name: ci-babysitter
plugins.description: Owns the push-to-green loop. After git push it starts a background CI watcher on the PR (needs gh auth); DENIES a push carrying unreviewed code and ASKS when no test ran this session; BLOCKS ending the session while the branch's CI is red or pending. With TEST_GATE_FILE/TEST_RUNNER in ~/.claude/local/kit.env it also routes a repo's tests through one runner. Per-repo tuning via ~/.claude/local/<repo>-ci.env.

plugins.name: auto-review
plugins.description: Review at git push with reproduce-first fixes, role-selected providers and a bounded review budget. Explicit installation enables blocking review hooks.

plugins.name: session-context
plugins.description: Project and item context, handoffs, a retro inbox and safe housekeeping. Per-user repository docs remain in your overlay.

plugins.name: python-hygiene
plugins.description: Runs ruff on every edited .py file, only in repos that already carry a ruff config (never reformats a repo that has not adopted it). Ships the conventions house-style skill for Python and SQL. No effect on non-Python edits.

plugins.name: terminal-signals
plugins.description: Cosmetic only: names your VS Code/iTerm terminal tab after the task and flags it busy/idle/needs-attention per session, with macOS completion sounds and banners. The completion chime fires only when the turn is really over, not when another Stop hook blocked. Changes no tool behavior.

plugins.name: skills-core
plugins.description: 10 passive skills: session-review, grilling, grill-with-docs, domain-modeling, pr-study, prototype, handoff, sentry-fix-issues, unslop, typescript-best-practices. Inert until invoked: installs no hooks.

plugins.name: workflow
plugins.description: Ticket-to-merge-ready commands: /kickoff (Jira ticket, worktree, one commit, PR, CI and review comments to green; takeover and sync modes), /jira (find/create/transition, driven by per-user prefs in ~/.claude/local/jira-prefs.md) and /address-review. Needs the Atlassian MCP and gh.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: The process-doc skill: a self-contained standalone HTML process guide (industrial design system, numbered floor steps, gate chips, config flow, screenshots from a reusable catalog). The screenshot catalog and company config notes live in ~/.claude/local/process-doc/.

plugins.name: qa-e2e
plugins.description: The qa-e2e skill: an end-to-end QA pass on a feature (backend up and seeded, the app driven on an Android emulator or the web, screenshots, findings by verification level, an ops SOP). Repo paths and seeds come from ~/.claude/local/qa-e2e/.
